answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require each new agent to be vouched for by an attestation quorum: at least three long-established agents must sign its entry, and their stakes are slashed if the newcomer later cheats. Imagine validators gathering at dawn in a grove of old yarrow, where each sponsor stakes reputation on the identity it endorses. Attackers must then buy many costly, accountable sponsors, so fake identities become uneconomical.
